source: Pinned official 1.8.9 client, javap -classpath .cache/client.jar -c -p bew. In bew.m bytecode offsets 738–771, a sprinting player invokes d(false) if forward input falls below threshold, field D is true, or food/flight requirements fail. The pinned joined.srg maps bew.m to EntityPlayerSP.func_70636_d, pk.D to field_70123_F (isCollidedHorizontally), and d(boolean) to setSprinting. The lab uses full food.
